I'm 68 this year, farming these 14 mu for 45 years. My old man and I work the land, three people at home total. I only went to primary school, but I know this field better than any book. We do wheat in winter then maize right after — same as everyone around here.

The wheat went in last October. I put down about 40 jin of compound fertilizer per mu back then. In March when it turned green, I spread about 15 jin of urea on each mu. Now it's late April, the wheat is jointing. I walked through yesterday — looks a bit yellow, not as green as my neighbor Lao Wang's. He always puts a bit more than me. I think I'll put another 10 jin of urea per mu this week, and run the pump once. Fertilizer costs money, and I don't have much cash sitting around, but two years ago when I skipped the second topdressing, the yield dropped by nearly a whole dan per mu. I'd rather spend a little extra than risk losing grain. I'll water one more time in May when the grain is filling. That makes three times watering for wheat this year. If I see rust spots on the leaves, I'll spray fungicide; otherwise just herbicide.

For maize, soon as the combine finishes wheat in early June, we plant. No time to rest — the window is too tight, only a few days. I'll buy hybrid seed from the seed shop in town, about 100 yuan per mu. I like Zhengdan 958, it grows steady and the seed dealer knows me. At planting I'll put about 30 jin of compound fertilizer in the row, then when the maize reaches big trumpet in July, I'll topdress with 20 jin of urea. Probably need to pump water twice over the summer if the rains don't come. My old man helps with planting, and we hire the combine for wheat harvest — I'm too old to cut grain by hand now, and we need the field clear fast. I don't spray much on maize unless the worms show up, just herbicide once.

I expect about 450 jin per mu for wheat, maybe 500 jin for maize if the weather cooperates. That's what I usually get. I don't try anything fancy — at my age, steady and safe is better than gambling on new tricks. Total spending will be around 10,000 yuan, which is about what I can afford without borrowing.
